title: TTCS: Test-Time Curriculum Synthesis for Self-Evolving
abstract: arXiv:2601.22628v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Test-Time Training offers a promising way to improve the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) by adapting the model using only the test questions. However, existing methods struggle with difficult reasoning problems for two reasons: raw test questions are often too difficult to yield high-quality pseudo-labels, and the limited size of test sets makes continuous online updates prone to instability. To address these limitations, we propose TTCS, a co-evolving test-time training framework. Specifically, TTCS initializes two policies from the same pretrained model: a question synthesizer and a reasoning solver. These policies evolve through iterative optimization: the synthesizer generates progressively challenging question variants conditioned on the test questions, creating a structured curriculum tailored to the solver's current capability, while the solver updates itself using self-consistency rewards computed from

translated_title: TTCS：面向自我进化的测试时课程合成
translated_abstract: 测试时训练为提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力提供了一种很有前景的方法，它仅利用测试问题来适配模型。然而，现有方法在应对困难推理问题时存在两大障碍：原始测试问题往往过于困难，难以产生高质量的伪标签；同时测试集规模有限，导致持续的在线更新容易不稳定。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了TTCS——一个共同进化的测试时训练框架。具体而言，TTCS从同一个预训练模型初始化两个策略：问题合成器与推理求解器。这两个策略通过迭代优化实现共同进化：合成器以测试问题为条件，生成难度逐步提升的问题变体，为求解器的当前能力量身打造结构化课程；而求解器则利用由（原文此处截断）计算得到的自洽性奖励来更新自身。
tldr: TTCS提出了一种共同进化的测试时训练框架，通过问题合成器与推理求解器的迭代协同优化，生成难度递增的课程化问题变体，从而提升大语言模型在困难推理问题上的能力。
en_tdlr: TTCS proposes a co-evolving test-time training framework in which a question synthesizer and a reasoning solver iteratively improve each other through progressively challenging curriculum question variants, enabling LLMs to tackle difficult reasoning problems.
